title: Primrose V3 Edit Plan
summary: Edit plan for Primrose HVAC install progress update video for social platforms.
content:
Primrose V3 Edit Plan

Client: Ambition Mechanical Project: Primrose HVAC Install - Progress Update Target: IG Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts (9:16, 1080x1920) Duration: 24s Editor: Cleo Date: 2026-03-09

Edit Pattern

Testimonial (Pattern 4) + Behind the Scenes (Pattern 6) hybrid.

Why: Marlon's on-site voice IS the content. He's the owner, talking while doing the work. That's the most authentic, highest-performing content format for construction. His voice carries trust. The visuals prove it. This isn't a talking-head testimonial; it's a self-testimonial from the field. The BTS element comes from showing the work nobody else sees (above-ceiling HVAC, rooftop units, wiring).

v2 got the audio-first approach right. v3 adds what v2 was missing: text overlays for muted viewers, a music bed with ducking, tighter visual variety, and a stronger first-frame hook.

What v2 Got Right (Keep These)

  • Branded back shot as the opening hook (src 86s)
  • Marlon's continuous voice as the backbone (src 43-67s)
  • Brand stinger closing ("Ambition Mechanical. We show up different.")
  • Visual variety over the voice track

What v2 Got Wrong (Fix These)

  1. No text overlays. 85% of social video is watched muted. Muted viewers get zero content from v2.
  2. No music bed. Raw on-site audio + voice works, but a subtle bed underneath adds polish and fills the quiet moments.
  3. Wiring shots dominate. Rows 3-4 of the v2 grid are nearly identical close-ups. Needs more shot variety.
  4. No hook text in first 2 seconds. The branded shirt is good visually but doesn't communicate what the content is about to muted viewers.
  5. No CTA. Ends on brand stinger VO but nothing on screen.

Shot-by-Shot Structure (v3)

Time Visual Source Text Overlay Audio
0-2.5s HOOK: Branded back shot, rooftop, blue sky. "AMBITION MECHANICAL SERVICES 480-600-2942" on the shirt. src 86s "HVAC INSTALL IN PROGRESS" (Barlow Condensed Bold, white on navy bar, top-center) Music intro (full volume)
2.5-5s SCALE: Drone top-down, 3 HVAC units, piping network src 90s "PRIMROSE" (large, center) fades in at 3s Music ducks as Marlon starts talking at 3s
5-7.5s ACTION: Tech climbing ladder into ceiling src 30s (clear for Marlon's voice) Marlon voice + music at 15%
7.5-10s HUMAN: Tech at ceiling panel, face + headlamp src 20s (clear for voice) Marlon voice + music at 15%
10-12.5s CRAFT (synced): Wiring hands close-up src 43s "HVAC CONTROLS" (lower third, small) Marlon voice (synced to hands) + music at 15%
12.5-14.5s ABOVE: Attic shot, tech working on HVAC unit src 28s (clear) Marlon voice + music at 15%
14.5-17s DETAIL: Cable work with tools src 55s "THE WORK YOU DON'T SEE" (center, fade in) Marlon voice + music at 15%
17-19s CONTEXT: Drone establishing shot, Primrose building src 4s (clear, let the wide shot breathe) Marlon voice fading, music rises to 40%
19-21.5s ROOF PAYOFF: Drone pulling back, finished rooftop install src 90s (different angle) "AMBITION MECHANICAL" (center, bold) Music at 50%, Marlon fades out
21.5-24s BRAND CLOSE: Tech by ladder, branded shirt visible, full body src 24s "WE SHOW UP DIFFERENT" + small "ambitionmechanical.com" below Brand stinger VO crossfades in, music fades

Text Overlay Spec

  • Font: Barlow Bold (Barlow Condensed not installed, Barlow Bold is the closest match)
  • Primary color: White (#FFFFFF)
  • Background bar: Navy (#1B2A4A) at 80% opacity
  • Accent: Red (#C41E3A) for key words
  • Position: Center-upper for hook text, lower-third for labels
  • Timing: Text appears slightly before or on the spoken word, never after
  • Duration: Minimum 1.5s per text element

Audio Plan

Three layers:

  1. Marlon's voice (0-21.5s): Source audio from 43-67s. Primary content. 100% volume. Fades out 1.5s starting at 20s.
  2. Music bed (0-24s): No music file available in the audio library. Will use the source ambient audio from the exterior drone shots (0-5s of source) as a subtle ambient bed, then let Marlon's voice dominate. If no usable ambient, the edit goes voice-only with the brand stinger.
  3. Brand stinger (21.5-24s): brand-stinger-ambition.mp3 (2.4s). Crossfades in as Marlon fades out.

Ducking strategy:

  • 0-3s: Full ambient/music
  • 3-21.5s: Music/ambient drops to 15% when Marlon speaks
  • 20-21.5s: Marlon fades out, ambient rises
  • 21.5-24s: Brand stinger at 90%, ambient fades to 0

The Hook (First 2 Seconds)

Three channels simultaneously:

  1. Visual: Branded orange shirt on rooftop against blue sky. Human figure, curiosity (who is this, what are they doing up there?)
  2. Text: "HVAC INSTALL IN PROGRESS" in Barlow Bold on a navy bar. Tells muted viewers exactly what they're watching. Algorithm indexes this for construction discovery.
  3. Audio: Music/ambient hit for the first 3s before Marlon starts. Creates presence.

This is the strongest single frame in the source footage. v1 and v2 already proved it works as the opener. v3 adds the text layer that was missing.

Pacing

Following 2-3-2 rule:

  • 2.5s (hook) - 2.5s (scale) - 2.5s (action) - 2.5s (human) - 2.5s (craft synced) - 2s (above) - 2.5s (detail) - 2s (context) - 2.5s (roof payoff) - 2.5s (brand close)
  • Average clip: 2.4s. Range: 2-2.5s. No clip exceeds 3s.
  • 10 clips in 24s = one cut every 2.4s. Tight enough for construction content, not frantic.

Self-Review Checklist (After Render)

  • First frame hooks visually AND with text
  • No two consecutive shots look the same (check grid)
  • Marlon's voice is clear and audible throughout speech section
  • Text overlays are readable at mobile size (1080x1920)
  • Audio ducking is smooth (no hard volume jumps)
  • Brand stinger lands cleanly at the end
  • Text appears with or before speech, never after
  • Total duration is 24s +/- 0.5s
  • Navy/white/red color scheme matches Ambition brand
  • No dead air or dead frames
